body:
Implements issue #3762 (D1-040, design in PR #3760): the documents/document session frame pair, modelled on records.

**Frames & serving**
- ClientFrame::Documents { capability, prefix, after } / ClientFrame::Document { capability, name }; ServerFrame::Documents { names, next_after } (deliberately no sequence — the listing is a point-in-time snapshot of the blob-store tag set) / ServerFrame::Document { name, size, text }.
- Serving logic (list_public_documents / read_public_document, name rules, 64 KiB read cap) moves from world_ssh.rs into the session layer (documents_session / document_session beside records_session); list paging uses the records byte-page rule with an exclusive next_after. Authorization is the records rule (join capability to participant, else "join denied"); failures ride send_error with the existing DocumentError strings.
- The store reaches the session via WorldService's blob store, or SessionConfig.documents_store for transports that hold the store directly (the SSH shell, per design decision 7's structural note) — threaded through both the query and joined phases.

**SSH shell becomes a rendering client**
- command_frame gains documents / documents_continue / document arms; the shell drains pages under the old list caps (512 items / 32 KiB of name lines) and renders the listing in the previous byte-identical format; /document renders the "--- {name} ({size} bytes; read-only) ---" header from the frame fields.

**Contract**
- documents / document added to shell-contract.v1.json (client + server) and to the shell_contract frame lists/tests.

**Tests**
- New session tests: listing order/content, prefix, exclusive after, read, parity (frame-served listing == rendered listing for the same store), refusal strings (missing / non-viewable / binary / oversized), join-denied for both frames, joined-phase list+read, and a page-budget unit test.
- Existing tests pass: documents_are_listed_read_and_refused_over_a_session, a_shell_lists_and_views_read_only_documents_from_its_server_store (ssh feature, frame-backed path), document_reader_limits_names_sizes_and_binary_content, records_are_paged_prefixed_and_queryable_while_joined, shell_contract suite (8 tests).

**Not in this PR** (remainder, tracked on the issue): the minimal web documents panel + web contract tests from design decision 8.

Fixes #3762 (core protocol + SSH parity; the web panel remainder is called out on the issue — if reviewers prefer, keep the issue open for that slice).

Queue: task 13221, lane code-k. Note: lane code-p parked task 13221 mid-implementation after a duplicate claim and named this lane's work canonical (issue comment 6721143123).
